regimeSub: Bessent debt buyback calms global bond rout; US consumer still cracking as Warsh stays pinned.
themes: Bessent deploys debt buybacks (Aug 19 Bloomberg) → 10Y UST eases to 4.71% from 4.72%, global yields follow as term premium repricing pauses; 2s10s still +52bp
JGB selloff persists (Aug 18 Asahi) → BOJ Sept hike odds firm; USDJPY sticky at 158.5 but yen carry unwind risk elevated as Takaichi fiscal concerns mount
July NFP -23K + retail sales largest drop in 12 months → Warsh boxed in at 3.63% rate despite 3.3% CPI; stagflation lite confirmed with 1.5% GDP print
KOSPI fades to 6756 after Aug 17 Samsung/SK Hynix pop → USDKRW softens to 1393 as DXY slips to 98.85; BOK Deputy Yu Aug 10 hike signal keeps won bid

headline: Bessent's buyback intervention stabilizes global bond rout while US stagflation lite regime persists—Warsh paralyzed by 3.3% CPI and -23K NFP as BOJ hike bets and JGB selloff keep yen carry risk elevated.
